typography.$description: Showrun typography — v1.0.0, locked 2026-08-06. Two families. Both free; both permit commercial use and read-only PDF embedding with unlimited distribution of the resulting PDFs. Font FILES may not be passed to an agency or printer — they download their own copy.

display.$description: Display and body. Variable. Fontshare / ITF Free Font License. Chosen because it complements the logo wordmark through shared flat-sided roundness without impersonating it — a system face that matched would make the lockup read as set type rather than a mark.

mono.$description: Labels, values, title blocks, FIG captions. Chosen on measured x-height: 60.5% against IBM Plex Mono's 51.6% — 17% taller at the same nominal size, which is what fixed small-label legibility.

body.$description: 400 read as too light. Fixed with weight plus leading and ink contrast, not a new family.

label.$description: Floor. Was 13px before the breathing-room pass; do not go back down.
